name: Omnara

modes.label: Managed machines
modes.note: Published tariff is memory-only: "$0.0414 per GiB of memory per hour online" (omnara.com/pricing, 2026-09-28); CPU is not billed separately (vcpu_h 0). vCPU per GiB and machine sizes are NOT published (create-machine API has no size fields), so the vCPU count of a priced shape is unverified. Retention "$0.20016 per GiB of memory per 30 days retained, in addition to runtime" is per GiB of machine memory, not per GiB of state, so it is not mapped to snapshot_gib_month.

caveats: Priced (fix 2026-09-28) on the published memory-hour rate only ($0.0414/GiB-h, CPU not billed separately). vCPU allocation per GiB is unpublished: a 4 vCPU request is NOT guaranteed. Retention of sleeping machines ($0.20016/GiB memory/30 days) is not included in the estimate.
Runtime $0.0414 per GiB memory-hour online. Retention $0.20016 per GiB MEMORY per 30 days, not disk GiB. CPU capacity-to-memory mapping unverified.
Idle sleep preserves data and pauses runtime; retaining machine still costs. BYO models/machines and Apache-2.0 self-hosting have $0 platform fee, but own compute/model bills remain.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Omnara Cloud is prepaid: managed sandboxes and managed models consume credits bought through Stripe; purchased credits are non-refundable; agents pause or fail when the organization has insufficient credits. Minimum purchase and any signup credit are not published ('No credit card required' to start).

Omnara is an agent control plane; its machines are sandboxes from Blaxel, Unikraft Cloud, Daytona or Modal. The provider, isolation and vCPU/RAM shape behind the Omnara-managed 'default-pool' are unpublished. With a BYO provider pool the compute is billed by that provider, not Omnara (Omnara platform fee $0).

Retention is charged 'in addition to runtime' for every retained machine (not only sleeping ones): while online the effective rate is $0.0414 + ~$0.000278 per GiB-hour. Pool machines are deleted after a configurable idle period (minimum 5 min; 0 disables), after which retention stops.

fleet.verification: No credit card for open-source self-hosting; hosted/Enterprise onboarding not specified.
fleet.tiers: Per agent: 1 machine by default ('By default, Omnara creates one machine at launch and allows one machine in total'), raised via max_machines within pool/project limits. Account-level limits of the hosted default-pool are unpublished.
fleet.notes: Current pricing offers open-source self-hosting and Enterprise deployment/on-prem support. No managed new-account VM quota established; customer-supplied infrastructure is not unlimited hosted fleet access.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: A pool machine keeps its files, installed dependencies, and running processes across turns, including when the provider suspends and resumes it while idle.
snapshot_auto.note: Pricing page: 'Idle machines auto-sleep, preserving data and pausing runtime charges.' Trigger = idle; running processes (memory) preserved. Mechanism is the underlying provider's suspend (Blaxel / Unikraft Cloud / Daytona / Modal); Modal pool machines hard-terminate at 24 h. Pool machines are deleted after the configured idle-deletion period; replacements start from the pool image/snapshot.

own_agent_api.quote: Omnara is an open source platform for running managed agents. It handles execution and state while you choose the models, tools, machines, and how users interact with each agent.
own_agent_api.note: Omnara's OWN agent harness only (not Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode). REST API, TypeScript SDK, CLI and MCP server: launch agent from YAML config, POST inputs (follow-ups, steering), SSE event stream with resume, approvals, cron triggers, webhooks. The agent loop runs in Omnara's control plane, not inside the machine; machines (omnarad daemon) are attached as tool execution environments.

secret_proxy.quote: secret_env_overlay references secrets, whose values are resolved when they are injected. Both apply to every process the agent runs on the machine
secret_proxy.note: Machine-side secrets are injected as env vars. Model-provider keys and MCP/OAuth tokens are used by the control-plane agent loop and never need to be on the machine, but there is no proxy for the machine's own outbound HTTP.
